data_exposure: All six Stage26 source dates already exposed; this is descriptive root-cause NOT new out-of-sample prediction or buy-signal filtering
sources: 36 Stage26 actual original GitHub CI 168h full-minutely SHA verified artifacts, immutable 36 ZIP SHA+inner JSON SHA prior proof

definitions.per_tick_group: day/date + exact original WATCH UTC 3m poll; exact minute timestamp; no rolling adjacency
definitions.bucket_0: ISOLATED_1 if exactly 1 currency WATCH in same original 3-minute timestamp
definitions.bucket_1: LOCAL_2_TO_7 if 2 to 7 currencies WATCH in same 3-minute timestamp
definitions.bucket_2: BURST_8PLUS if 8 or more currencies WATCH in same 3-minute timestamp
definitions.multiple_watches_same_symbol: Count each original actual original WATCH event; do not duplicate same-symbol closed data across grouping
definitions.trade_proxy: At most first non-overlapping same-symbol 24h lock from source; each subsequent overlap has explicit SKIP_SAME_SYMBOL_24H_CAPITAL_OCCUPIED and must be kept separate
definitions.returns: Use only source-generated fixed24h buy 3min after WATCH, 10bps fee/side, 20bps or100bps slippage/side. Existing actual source censoring respected; no new history prices calculated or filled.
definitions.gross_2x: Stage26 TRUE if high touched original frozen date06UTC open *2 sometime in 168h, not proof WATCH caused tradable2x; report first WATCH lead and 6h recency separately
definitions.censorship: Keep 257 non-evaluable proxy trades, 326 same-symbol 24h overlapping events, and all 1,829 source failures unaltered
definitions.market_regime_independence: Original calendar date is independent cluster, not individual watch symbol; report per-date bucket losses and 6-day distribution, do not treat 549 proxies as independent regime samples
definitions.missing_feature_limit: Original Stage26 artifacts lack WATCH 24h volume, momentum trigger payload and bid/ask depth; do not infer them. Need fresh source collection or separate versioned model run for such features.

hypotheses: H0: model WATCH predictive 24h net outcomes do not reliably differ between 1,2-7,8+ concurrent signatures after fee/censoring
H1 diagnostic: synchronized 8+ WATCH clusters may have different net-price proxies, but six exposed dates insufficient to claim any profitable strategy
H2: a market-wide burst can make WATCH→D1 global latency inadequate without implying all late candidates lose
mandatory_output: 1132 sample total, exact per-day and 3m bucket assignments, all source trade status
for each bucket: valid wins losses median mean, 20bps and100bps, censored fractions, gross2x and WATCH recency
day-held-out descriptive stability of sign, day bootstrap/no fake statistical n=549 independent
burst event 2026-02-06T00:36:00Z token list with price proxy and censoring (no manual selection)
eligible future test must include distinct unseen dates and normal symbols; NO threshold changes and no trading recommendation
